findings.summary: The frozen baseline derives from order.toasttab.com/online/bandit-taco, which identifies New Hampshire Ave/U-Street, while the scoped restaurant is Tenleytown. This explains multiple U-Street-only or stale frozen products and invalidates location-specific equivalence assumptions.

Luna emitted no current products despite an accessible, fully readable linked Toast catalog. Terra verified the current menu boundary and identified omitted food, family-meal, beverage, and FOOD (3PD) service entries.

Frozen allergen arrays labeled official ingredients cannot be verified for Tenleytown. The available menu is restaurant-linked vendor content with partial named-ingredient positives only; it provides no complete arrays, negative claims, may-contain claims, or cross-contact statement.

summary: Identity and the complete visible Tenleytown Toast menu are verified, but Luna missed the current catalog entirely. The frozen data is materially inconsistent with the scoped location because its configured Toast URL is U-Street. No restaurant-issued allergen or cross-contact source was found; only partial positive ingredient evidence from restaurant-linked Toast is available. All 113 frozen audit keys are reconciled exactly once above, with no allergen negatives or may-contain claims inferred.
